app.name: B1 Kompass
app.tagline: German A2–B1 practice: DTZ Hören and Lesen

home.title: Practise for the German DTZ exam
home.description: Listening and reading tasks from a real practice exam. No email or password needed.
home.busy: Too many people are starting right now. Please try again in a minute.
home.note: A guest session lasts 30 days from the first visit in this browser.

hoeren.title: Hören · listening
hoeren.text: Audio tasks in the DTZ format, Teil 1–4, with the recording of the exam.

lesen.title: Lesen · reading
lesen.text: Reading tasks in the DTZ format, Teil 1–5, checked by the server.

choice.timedBlockDetail: One block against the clock: Hören or Lesen, with the time of the exam. The time keeps running if you pause the recording or leave the page.
choice.guestTooShort: Your guest session ends too soon for this timed block. Choose the free training, or start the block in a new guest session.
choice.replaceOpen: Start in a new guest session
choice.replaceNotNeeded: Your current session is long enough for this block. You can start it now.

replace.title: Start a new guest session?
replace.tooShort: Your current guest session ends too soon for this timed block, and it cannot be extended.
replace.history: Your earlier attempts and results are not deleted, but once the new session starts they are no longer available in this browser. Other browsers are not affected.
replace.english: The new session starts in English. The block you chose starts right after it.
replace.busy: Too many new sessions right now. Please try again in a minute.
replace.error: The session was not replaced. Please try again.

choice.examDetail: The whole exam against the clock: Hören ({hoeren} min), a pause of up to {transition} s, then Lesen with its full time ({lesen} min). The recording plays once, without pause or rewind. The time runs on the server.

examAudio.ready: The recording is ready. The exam and the recording start together with this button.
examAudio.stale: Renewing the recording before the start…
examAudio.error: The recording could not be prepared. The exam cannot start without it.
examAudio.conflict: A training of this exam is already in progress. Continue it first.

save.error: Your answer was not saved. Your choice is still selected.
save.refused: This answer cannot be saved because the attempt is no longer open. Reload the page.
save.sessionInvalid: Your guest session has ended. Start a new guest session to continue.

audio.label: Recording
audio.ready: The recording is ready. Play it as often as you like.
audio.error: The recording could not be loaded. You can still answer, and your answers are saved.
audio.examReady: The recording plays once, in step with the exam time, without pause or rewind.
audio.examBlocked: Your browser blocked the sound. Press Play to continue at the exam position.

hoeren.intro: Hören, {isRange, select, true {parts {first} to {last}} other {part {first}}}: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}, one answer each.{hasPairs, select, true { In part 3 the two questions of one conversation are shown together.} other {}}{hasSharedSet, select, true { In part 4 the whole list of statements a–f stays visible for all three questions.} other {}} You can change an answer at any time while the recording keeps playing.
hoeren.pairLegend: One conversation, two questions: {first} and {second}. Answer each one separately.
hoeren.sharedSetLegend: Hören, part 4: one list of statements a–f for questions {first} to {last}. Choose one statement for each question.

lesen.missingText: The text for this task is missing from the material, so the task cannot be shown. Go to another task.

set.goTo: {count, plural, one {Go to question {number}} other {Go to questions {number}}}, {state, select, answered {answered} partial {partly answered} other {not answered}}
set.answered: Answered: {answered} of {total}. Unanswered questions count as skipped.

results.title: Result
results.restartError: A new run could not be started. Please try again.
results.noLevel: This result covers only part of the exam. Its points are not an official DTZ level.
results.untimedFull: Free training of the whole set, without a time limit.
results.repeatEmpty: Nothing to repeat: every task of this result is right.
results.repeatError: The repeat could not be started. Please try again.

error.message: Something went wrong. Your saved answers are kept.

timedLeave.title: The time keeps running
timedLeave.body: Going to the library does not pause this attempt. The countdown runs on our server and continues while you are away.
timedLeave.hint: You can come back with “Continue” while time is left. Your saved answers are kept.

training.finishError: The answers were not submitted. Your answers are kept. Please try again.
training.confirmBody: Unanswered: Hören {hoeren}, Lesen {lesen}. Unanswered tasks count as skipped and cannot be answered afterwards.
training.confirmRenewed: The numbers have changed since you looked. Please check them and confirm again.
training.finishUncertain: The connection was lost while submitting. Your answers are locked until the server answers; send the same submission again.
training.accepted: Your answers are accepted and can no longer be changed. The result is being prepared.
training.resultNotReady: The result is not ready yet. Your accepted answers are kept; please try again.
training.cancelBody: The attempt ends without a result and cannot be continued. Answers already saved stay; tasks without a saved answer: {skipped}.
training.cancelUnsaved: {unsaved, plural, one {# choice is} other {# choices are}} not saved yet and will be lost.
training.cancelError: The attempt was not cancelled. Please try again.
training.cancelUncertain: The connection was lost while cancelling. Send the same cancel again.
training.expired: Time is up. Only the answers saved before the end of the time count.
training.expiredUnsaved: {unsaved, plural, one {# choice was} other {# choices were}} not saved in time and {unsaved, plural, one {does} other {do}} not count.
training.confirmUnopened: {count, plural, one {# Lesen task has} other {# Lesen tasks have}} not started yet and will count as skipped.
